Refero, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS variable generated from tokens.json, read from refero.design and styles.refero.design on 2026-11-02: the sites' own variables where one matches what the page paints, and computed styles of the real elements everywhere else. Each token's source is in the tables. Toggle Dark for the theme both hosts apply under prefers-color-scheme.

Two surfaces, one system: refero.design is the design-research app (a 270px left rail, the centred research card, screenshot galleries, pricing, MCP); styles.refero.design is the public styles gallery (a translucent top bar, the video-tile card index, a documentation page per style). They share the same gray scales and semantic names; each adds a display serif (Title / kalice, replaced by Instrument Serif here) and a UI sans (Base-Variable / neueMontreal, replaced by Inter). Component mock-ups are drawn with the tokens; the real components are the crops in components.md.

Palette

One shared palette. The neutral ramp is ten solid greys plus an alpha scale (translucent navy-blacks for text, borders and glass) and a glass scale for blurred overlays; three status accents; a 24-hue code ramp in muted and vivid saturations; and constant dark shades for paywall blocks. The dark theme inverts the ramp: gray.solid.0 = #101216, gray.solid.900 = #fff.

Roles

The semantic layer: background, text, border, action, status and component colours in the current theme — aliases into the palette where the chain ends on a scale step.

TokenValueSource

Typography

Body and UI text sit at 16/24 with tight -0.02em tracking; chips at 14/20 (refero.design) or 13/24 tracked out (styles.refero.design). Display lines are serif: Title 50/60 on refero.design pages, kalice 64/69 on the styles hero and 48/48 on a style's page.

Families

TokenStackSource

Space and shape

Spacing

A 4px unit (--spacing on the styles host); measured paddings land on the same grid: 8, 12, 14, 16, 18, 30.

Radius

Small controls 6-12, cards 16, the research box and coach box 24, the CTA pill 28, and the signature styles-gallery tile 32.

Layout and focus

TokenValueSource

Elevation

Almost no drop shadows: surfaces are separated by fills and hairlines. The two exceptions are the research box's 1px inset ring and the floating MCP card's two-layer drop shadow; the white chip pills carry a tiny 1px keyline shadow.

Motion

Quiet and fast: 150-200ms ease transitions on controls, a 400ms slide for the coach box, and the signature 500ms opacity fade that brings the scroll-preview video in over a card's poster image. Click a track to play its curve.

Focus

refero.design falls back to the browser's auto outline (1px #005fcc) on CTAs and links, plus the research chips' own 2px ring shadow; styles.refero.design draws a 2-3px ring shadow in the --ring colour at half alpha. The research input and the result cards show no visible change on focus at all.

Web appsresearch chip: 2px ring shadow
Get startedCTA: browser auto outline
Copystyles host: 3px ring-shadow rgba(111,113,121,.5)

Layout

Read at 1440 x 900. refero.design's shell is a fixed 270px left rail over a max-width 1600 content wrap (the measured column is 1170 wide, padded 48); styles.refero.design uses a translucent 81px sticky top bar over an 1800 max-width wrap and a 1100 hero.

Dark theme

Toggle Dark above: the gray scale inverts (fills go #101216/#1a1c23/#2a2d37), text goes to #fff, accents dim slightly. Both hosts apply it under prefers-color-scheme: dark; refero.design can also pin it manually with body#dark-theme.
